AdaptiveLearner could not be found at the folder we remembered from last time.

If you moved or renamed the AdaptiveLearner folder, click 'Choose folder' and point to the new location.

If you removed AdaptiveLearner and have not reinstalled it yet, click 'Open install guide'.

stale.message:
This launcher installs AdaptiveLearner {target}, but the latest release is {latest}.

Download a newer launcher to install the current AdaptiveLearner, or continue with this older version if that is what you want.

start.compose_failed.message:
AdaptiveLearner could not start. This usually happens when another program is using port {port}, or when Docker Desktop is having trouble.

Try the following: close other programs that might use the same port, restart Docker Desktop, then open AdaptiveLearner again.
start.compose_failed.title: Could not start AdaptiveLearner
start.health_timeout.message:
AdaptiveLearner did not finish starting within a minute.

This can happen on the first start when Docker needs to prepare the application for the first time.

Click Retry to wait another minute, or Cancel to shut down.
start.health_timeout.title: AdaptiveLearner is taking longer than expected
